review_role: Independent native instrumentation author reviewing analyzer and archival output, not author of analyzer or its tests.
scope: Binary frame and selected-cell ownership; missing and duplicated records; mandatory phases and measured single-loop / sedimentation substep coverage.
Native-first interpolation; absent conditional phases remain NaN; sampled source-order float32 arithmetic and paired and intercall interpretation.
Source, receipt, history, input and output identity bindings; sampled four-corner raw records and independently recomputed point products.
All five lossless array manifests and original NPY payload byte, dtype, shape and order reconstruction.
limitations: The raw-record arithmetic review samples one point, four corners, three levels and the first timestep per arm; exhaustive capture checks are established by the analyzer receipt.
Point and intercall changes are descriptive fixed-location differences and do not establish trajectory, transport-only, or causal attribution.
